verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik:
Al masanil juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato a junok ix ix tz'aj junok swinak unin, yowalil uke' k'ual manh sakok yaj ix icha sleyal, ichataxon yik syilan sb'islab' uj ix t'a juntak el.
T'a wal yukub'ixial yaj jun winak unin chi', tz'ak'ji kirkunkidar.

Axo pax ix nunab'il chi', 33 k'ualto manh wach'ok tz'ajkan ix, ichato wanto sakb'itan sb'a ix, max yal-laj syaman junok tas ix to wik yaji, max yalpax sb'at ix b'aj ay in kajnub' ayik manto tz'akwok juntzanh k'ual chi'.
Palta tato ix unin tz'aj jun, 14 k'ual tz'eq'ui ayik manto sakok yaj ix, ichataxon tz'aj t'a sb'islab' uj t'a juntak el, slajwi chi' 66 k'ual skan ix yik sakb'itan sb'a.

Ayik stz'akwi juntzanh k'ual yik sakb'itan sb'a ix yuj yune' ix alji chi', wach'chom winak unin ma ix unin, yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal ix silab'il yet' junok nok' yalnhej makanhil paramuch, syak' ix silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul. Ha juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji t'a junok winh sakerdote t'a yichanh mantiado.
Axo jun winh sakerdote chi' tz'ak'an t'ayin silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix. Haton juntzanh sleyal tik ayik tz'alji winak unin, ma ix unin.

Palta tato a ix nunab'il chi' malaj junok nok' skalnel chi' syal yak'ani, syik'kot chawanhok nok' paramuch ix yalnhej tas makanhil, jun nok' stz'a silab'il, jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul. Axo junok winh sakerdote tz'ak'an silab'il yik wach' tz'ak'ji tup smul ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan ix, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
